title: Moshier planet coefficient tables (PlantTbl + scripted transcription)
description:
Port the Moshier planetary coefficient data from swemptab.h (~10,640 lines) to Rust const arrays. This is pure data — no algorithms.

## What to build

### 1. PlantTbl struct (src/moshier/mod.rs or types)

The C `struct plantbl` (sweph.h:698–706):
```c
struct plantbl {
  char max_harmonic[9];    // max harmonic multiplier per fundamental argument
  char max_power_of_t;     // highest power of T in polynomial amplitudes
  signed char *arg_tbl;    // argument table encoding which fundamentals enter each term
  double *lon_tbl;         // longitude coefficients
  double *lat_tbl;         // latitude coefficients
  double *rad_tbl;         // radius coefficients
  double distance;         // mean distance (AU)
};
```

Rust equivalent: a struct with `&'static` references to const arrays. No heap allocation.

### 2. Transcription script

Write a Python script (`tools/gen_moshier_tables.py`) that:
- Parses swemptab.h (at `../../swisseph/swemptab.h` relative to tools/)
- Extracts all 9 planet table sets: mer404, ven404, ear404, mar404, jup404, sat404, ura404, nep404, plu404
- For each planet: lon_tbl (doubles), lat_tbl (doubles), rad_tbl (doubles), arg_tbl (signed bytes), max_harmonic[9], max_power_of_t, distance
- Generates `src/moshier/tables.rs` with Rust `const` arrays and `PlantTbl` instances

The arg_tbl encoding is non-trivial — see c-ref-moshier.md for details on sentinel values and skip markers. The script must preserve the exact byte sequence.

### 3. Verification

After running the script:
- All 9 PlantTbl instances compile
- Element counts match C: for each planet, verify len(lon_tbl), len(lat_tbl), len(rad_tbl), len(arg_tbl) against the C arrays
- Add a `#[test]` in a test module that asserts these counts

### Table sizes (approximate element counts from C)

| Planet  | lon_tbl | lat_tbl | rad_tbl | arg_tbl |
|---------|---------|---------|---------|---------|
| Mercury | ~285    | ~285    | ~285    | ~130    |
| Venus   | ~226    | ~226    | ~226    | ~108    |
| Earth   | ~290    | ~290    | ~290    | ~135    |
| Mars    | ~440    | ~440    | ~440    | ~201    |
| Jupiter | ~344    | ~344    | ~344    | ~142    |
| Saturn  | ~487    | ~487    | ~487    | ~215    |
| Uranus  | ~382    | ~382    | ~382    | ~177    |
| Neptune | ~120    | ~120    | ~120    | ~59     |
| Pluto   | ~389    | ~389    | ~389    | ~173    |

The generated tables.rs will be ~10k+ lines. That's fine — it's pure data.

## Module structure

```
src/moshier/
  mod.rs      — PlantTbl struct definition, pub use of table instances
  tables.rs   — generated const arrays (do not hand-edit)
```

## C source reference
- swemptab.h:1–10640 — all coefficient arrays
- sweph.h:698–706 — struct plantbl definition
- See docs/c-ref-moshier.md for detailed format documentation

## Dependencies
- None within this arc (only needs types from Phase 0)
